name: Vehicle
description: Stores vehicle information for parking violations and ticket tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the vehicle record

fields.name: licensePlate
fields.description: Vehicle license plate number

fields.name: state
fields.description: State or jurisdiction of vehicle registration

fields.name: make
fields.description: Vehicle manufacturer (e.g., Toyota, Ford)

fields.name: model
fields.description: Vehicle model name

fields.name: color
fields.description: Primary color of the vehicle

fields.name: registrationExpiry
fields.description: Vehicle registration expiration date

constraints.uniqueLicensePlate: Combination of licensePlate and state must be unique

name: ParkingTicket
description: Stores parking ticket records with violation details, status, and financial information

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique ticket number identifier

fields.name: vehicleId
fields.description: Reference to the vehicle that received the ticket

fields.name: violationType
fields.description: Type of parking violation (e.g., expired meter, no parking zone, handicap violation)

fields.name: location
fields.description: Street address or location where violation occurred

fields.name: issuedAt
fields.description: Date and time when ticket was issued

fields.name: fineAmount
fields.description: Fine amount in dollars

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current ticket status (e.g., issued, paid, contested, overdue)

fields.name: photoUrl
fields.description: URL to photo evidence of the violation

relationships.description: Each ticket is associated with one vehicle

name: Payment
description: Records payment transactions for parking tickets including transaction details, amounts, and payment methods

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the payment transaction

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the parking ticket being paid

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Payment amount in currency units

fields.name: paymentMethod
fields.description: Method of payment (credit_card, debit_card, cash, check, online)

fields.name: transactionId
fields.description: External payment gateway transaction identifier

fields.name: paymentDate
fields.description: Date and time when payment was processed

fields.name: status
fields.description: Payment status (completed, pending, failed, refunded)

fields.name: gatewayResponse
fields.description: JSON string containing payment gateway response details

relationships.description: Links payment to the associated parking ticket

constraints.paymentMethod: Must be one of: credit_card, debit_card, cash, check, online
constraints.status: Must be one of: completed, pending, failed, refunded

name: Appeal
description: Manages appeal submissions and review process for contested parking tickets

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the appeal

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the parking ticket being appealed

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Appellant's explanation for contesting the ticket

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current appeal status (submitted, under_review, approved, denied)

fields.name: submittedDate
fields.description: Date and time when the appeal was submitted

fields.name: reviewedDate
fields.description: Date and time when the appeal was reviewed and decided

fields.name: reviewerNotes
fields.description: Notes and justification from the reviewer regarding the decision

fields.name: supportingDocuments
fields.description: URLs or file paths to uploaded evidence documents
